community.title: Thanks for downloading and building Glyph yourself.
community.body: Support the project with the official license to get automatic updates and the official build.

earlyAccess.title: Help shape Glyph
earlyAccess.body: Glyph is actively evolving and changing, so you may run into rough edges here and there. If something feels off, I'd really love to hear about it.

language.title: Language
language.label: App language
language.description: Choose the language used by Glyph's interface.
language.systemDescription: Uses your operating system language when Glyph supports it, otherwise English.

shortcuts.title: Customize Shortcuts
shortcuts.help: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want to use. Shortcuts save automatically and need Cmd, Ctrl, or Option plus another key.
